---
title: "Data Science program evaluation"
---

## Setup

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| echo: false
#| message: false

library(conflicted)
library(dplyr)
conflicts_prefer(dplyr::filter)
library(gtsummary)
library(here)
library(purrr)
library(readxl)
library(stringr)
library(tidyr)

incoming_dsci_major_students_survey_file <- here(
  "data",
  "raw",
  "incoming-dsci-major-students-survey.qs2"
)

coded_responses_file <- here(
  "data",
  "raw",
  "incoming-dsci-major-students-survey.xlsx"
)
```

### Qualtrics survey data

This workflow assumes that you generated a [Qualtrics API key](https://api.qualtrics.com/ZG9jOjg3NjYzMg-api-key-authentication) and saved it securely with `keyring::key_set("qualtrics_api_key")` in your OS's secure secret store.
In addition, request access to the Qualtrics Data Science surveys from Stephan Koenig.

```{r}
#| label: qualtrics
#| eval: false
#| echo: false

# Do only once per system
# keyring::key_set("qualtrics_api_key")
qualtRics::qualtrics_api_credentials(
  api_key = keyring::key_get("qualtrics_api_key"),
  base_url = "ubc.yul1.qualtrics.com"
)

surveys <- qualtRics::all_surveys()
incoming_dsci_major_students_survey_id <-
  surveys$id[surveys$name == "Incoming DSCI Major students survey"]
qualtRics::fetch_survey(incoming_dsci_major_students_survey_id) |>
  qs2::qs_save(incoming_dsci_major_students_survey_file)
```

## Analysis

```{r}
#| label: load-data
#| echo: false

incoming_students_survey <-
  qs2::qs_read(incoming_dsci_major_students_survey_file) |>
  janitor::clean_names()

completed_incoming_students_survey <- incoming_students_survey |>
  filter(progress >= 89)

sheet_names <- str_c("q", 3:6)
coded_responses <- map(
  sheet_names,
  \(sheet) {
    read_xlsx(
      coded_responses_file,
      sheet = sheet,
      skip = 1
    ) |>
      janitor::clean_names()
  }
) |>
  reduce(
    \(x, y) {
      full_join(
        x,
        y,
        by = join_by(
          response_id
        ),
        relationship = "one-to-one"
      )
    }
  )

coded_survey <- left_join(
  completed_incoming_students_survey,
  coded_responses,
  by = join_by(response_id)
)
```

```{r}
#| label: information
#| echo: false

coded_survey |>
  select(!c(q2_11, q2_11_text)) |>
  pivot_longer(starts_with("q2"), values_to = "information_source") |>
  count(information_source, sort = TRUE)
```

```{r}
#| label: application-process
#| echo: false

coded_survey |>
  separate_longer_delim(q3_coded, delim = "; ") |>
  tbl_summary(include = q3_coded)
```

```{r}
#| label: ranking
#| echo: false

coded_survey |>
  separate_longer_delim(q4_coded, delim = "; ") |>
  tbl_summary(include = q4_coded)
```

```{r}
#| label: interests
#| echo: false

coded_survey |>
  separate_longer_delim(q5_coded, delim = "; ") |>

```

```{r}
#| label: concerns
#| echo: false

coded_survey |>

```
